note: ML Model Factory 'Pipelines' feature (ml-model/page.jsx Pipelines tab) — code & workflow preprocessing pipelines. Distinct from api-data/model-studio.json, which documents the separate Forecast Studio sub-feature under the same model-studio route group.

backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object|array|null }
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> — injected globally by src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js, never per-route

plantField.name: plant_code_id
plantField.note: Rule 0: body field for POST/PUT, query param for GET/DELETE. availableTools is the one exception — global tool catalog, not plant-scoped, per pipelineService.js comment (table shows no request params for it either).

migrationHistory: 2026-07-14: reported bug was GET /api/modelfactory/pipeline/pipeline-list 404ing. Root cause: all 10 pipeline routes under src/app/api/modelfactory/pipeline/* still pointed at the old bare MODEL_STUDIO host with snake_case leaf paths (pre-refactor contract), while the sibling /overview endpoint had already migrated to the MODEL_FACTORY gateway.

2026-07-14/15: discovered a second, already-started migration in flight — src/services/model-studio/ml-model/pipelineService.js existed (plant_code-threaded, {success,data} envelope) expecting proxy routes at /api/model-studio/pipeline/* that had never been created, mirroring the already-completed Model Registry/Experiments/Artifacts moves off the old modelfactory/* namespace. Completed that migration instead of patching the old namespace: created the 10 src/app/api/model-studio/pipeline/* routes, deleted src/app/api/modelfactory/pipeline/* entirely, removed the pipeline section from modelService.js, and rewired useMLModelPage.js + PipelinesTab.jsx to pipelineService.js.

Deleted as dead code in the same pass: src/hooks/workflow-management/usePipelines.js (609-line duplicate hook, zero importers — the real page used useMLModelPage.js) and src/app/api/modelfactory/pipeline/delete-pipeline/route.js (exact duplicate of delete/route.js, zero callers).

endpoints.name: runPipeline
endpoints.description: Preview-executes preprocessing() against live IoTDB data without saving. Stage failures (fetch/compile/execute) return HTTP 400 with a body carrying a stage field — handled via bodyOrErr so the console output isn't lost.

endpoints.name: uploadPipeline
endpoints.description: Saves a new code pipeline. Extracts preprocessing() from pasted code, validates against real IoTDB data, stores only if validation passes. tags/start/end are validation-only, not persisted.

endpoints.name: updatePipeline
endpoints.description: Updates an existing code pipeline. Code is always re-extracted/re-validated. Only 'code' type pipelines accepted here.

requestParams.pipeline_id: query, per pre-existing route convention (not shown in original body sample)

endpoints.name: getAvailableTools
endpoints.description: Returns every tool available for the drag-and-drop canvas. Global catalog, not plant-scoped — table shows no request params.

endpoints.name: uploadWorkflow
endpoints.description: Saves a new workflow pipeline from the canvas. iot_data_fetch is stripped before storage (canvas-only data node); at least one preprocessing step must remain.

endpoints.name: updateWorkflow
endpoints.description: Partial update for a saved workflow pipeline. At least one field required. iot_data_fetch stripped automatically if steps provided. Only 'workflow' type pipelines accepted.

endpoints.name: runWorkflow
endpoints.description: Preview-executes a workflow before saving (validator + executor, nothing stored). Frontend must call this before allowing SAVE.
endpoints.notes: Per-step field is 'metadata' (rows/columns/total_nulls/column_stats), NOT 'after' or 'diff' as the pre-refactor UI code assumed — useMLModelPage.js's handleVisualTestRun was updated to read step.metadata and drop the nonexistent per-step diff render.

endpoints.name: getPipelines
endpoints.description: Returns all saved pipelines ordered by created_at DESC.

plantCodeId.note: table showed no request params for this row; sent anyway per CLAUDE.md Rule 0 (overrides Swagger silence).

endpoints.notes: No tags/start/end fields in list or details responses despite being accepted on create/update — those are validation-only inputs, not persisted/returned. Pre-existing UI fallback chains (pipe.tags/pipe.start/pipe.end) resolve to empty defaults; not a regression introduced by this migration.

endpoints.name: getPipeline
endpoints.description: Returns full details for a single pipeline. type='code' -> data.code; type='workflow' -> data.steps.
